text: Saputo Inc. is a Toronto-listed dairy processor controlled by the Saputo family through Jolina Capital, with a large family insider block. Quebec's public pension manager CDPQ holds a minority financial stake of roughly 4.5% after a September 2024 purchase, so there is a small state-fund presence but no state control. The Bologna front sponsorship is private family-controlled corporate money.

source.name: La Caisse (CDPQ), 'CDPQ increases its stake in Saputo Inc.'
